Subject: Beaches Tanning Center - Server Locking Up
Description:
Hey Guys, 

Just looking for some help, We have been having issues with our Sunlync for over a year now.  The main issue that we seem to have narrowed down to is when we click on the account ledger tab, it takes 5 to 10 minutes to load, then it seems to crash all the other locations. 

Below is an example query from the MySQL slow query log, I see multiple instances of the same query in the log since I enabled the log last week. 

SELECT a1.Date, a1.Description, a1.Amount, a1.ClientNumber, a1.TranType, a1.LedgerNumber, a1.MembershipID, a1.EFTTransNo, EFTADJUSTMENTLOG.OtherFeesReversed, if(a1.TranType="D", a1.Amount, 0.00) As "Debit", if(a1.TranType="C", a1.Amount, 0.00) As "Credit", a1.Balance, SUM(if(a2.ledgertype = 2, a2.amount, 0.00)) AS "EFTBalance", SUM(if(a2.ledgertype < 2, a2.amount, 0.00)) AS "NonEFTBalance", CONCAT_WS(", ",EMPLOYEES.LastName,EMPLOYEES.FirstName) AS Emp, STORES.StoreLocation, a1.Type, a1.Cleared, a1.LedgerType, a1.SubType FROM accountledger a1 INNER JOIN accountledger a2 ON a1.clientnumber = a2.clientnumber AND a2.DATE <= a1.DATE AND a2.ledgernumber <= a1.ledgernumber LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEES ON a1.EmployeeNumber = EMPLOYEES.EmployeeNumber LEFT JOIN STORES ON a1.StoreCode = STORES.StoreCode LEFT JOIN EFTADJUSTMENTLOG ON a1.EFTTransNo = EFTADJUSTMENTLOG.EFTTransNo and EFTADJUSTMENTLOG.Type="B" WHERE a1.clientnumber = "0000015224" GROUP by a1.ledgernumber ORDER BY a1.ledgernumber DESC;

The example query ran for 143.7 seconds and examined 17,420,458 rows.

During one of the server lock ups, I observed the above query (for a different clientnumber) causing multiple table locks, once I killed the query, all other table locks were freed.

Please let me know next steps. 

Thanks 

Brian Pender

Subject: New biometrics no longer compatible in sunlync back office
Description:
Matthew emailed the Support inbox:

Hello Sunlync Team,

I hope this email finds you well. We are trying to install a replacement biometrics at our Port Coquitlam store and have come across an issue with the Sunlync settings.

The biometric device is the EXACT same brand and model… and in the past this has been a simple unplug old one and plug in new one – same driver… easy... however this is not working anymore. I investigated deeper and found that the more recent biometrics have software Version 5 (it shows when looking in the properties in devices and printers)… and the older purchases were software version 4. In Sunlync back office > Store Parameters there is only an option to select up to version 4. See pic attached.
In the device properties it also has several options in regards to the driver – install / update / uninstall / roll back to previous version etc etc… however they are all greyed out except the first one - update driver… which I have tried and it immediately said I was using the most update correct driver. 

When plugging in the newer units… they light up blue / red like normal for a few seconds… then go off. In the windows Control Panel > Devices and Printers it shows “device is working properly” however when trying to use in Sunlync a message pops up saying no biometrics is attached. 

Please reply with a solution here or if this is a known issue – let me know a time where we can remote in and you can assist in this installation. If you need any further information or evidence of the above – I am happy to share screen grabs or remote in with you to show the details.

Thanks in advance, I look forward to hearing from you.

Matthew Joselin
SunScape Tanning Studios
Head Office

Description:
Good afternoon,

You can try locating the Timer Control Module in the base of the unit. Once moved to the outside of the unit, see if it lights up. If so, you can set time with that. But if it does not light up, then the unit must have an error on the display (which we cannot see).

If your decor lights for this unit are not coming on, then we also likely have an error on the display. Since we cannot see the display, our options are:

  *
Investigate the display and its connections to the rest of the unit. If we can reconnect the display or get it working, great!
  *
Get a technician with a service PC on site to connect to the unit. This way we can see what is wrong with the unit before we start ordering parts.
  *
Replace the display. This is a shot in the dark as it may not solve the issue. But cannot tell what the issue is, since we cannot see what the current display shows.

I'm looping in our support team to see if there is anything else we can try.

Hello guys.

I wanted to reach out about some issues I am having that I am told there is no permanent fix for. My Sunrise 7200 S/N 1502998 will randomly shut off the bulbs about a minute into a session, go into a 2 minute countdown and at the end of that a client can hit the start button and it turns back on for the remaining time the bed was set for. Another random event is that the bed when trying to start up will throw an E100 error code that will not clear without a full power cycle.  I have spoken to service (Henry mostly) and the temporary fix im given is about a 20 minute process of resetting the timer.  The bed seems to work fine for half a day to 2 days, and then it starts happening again.

Your service team does not have a permanent fix.  I have been told some beds it doesn't happen with and some it does. I am told it is a software issue. Asking if some do and some dont if getting the timer replaced could fix it, I am told it could be that or a board or a number of other things and your company has requested software updates from Germany, but who knows when/if that will happen.
Doing some research I understand this is not a new issue, but a known issue that has been around a lot longer than when the unit was sold to me.

This is hurting my business in a bad way. I have a dozen customers that have experienced this issue more than once, and some have not been back.

I need a permanent fix for this before I lose more customers and before my business gets a reputation for beds that break down and have problems all the time.

Hi, 
I'm not exactly sure who I should be emailing, so please forward this to whomever can assist if I do not have the correct email. I need some assistance regarding a Wellsystem Wave. We have a few of them and all but one are operating as they should. I went into the settings to see the differences and there are a few things I noticed:

1. Under the "massage settings" tab, we ONLY see "intensity at start" and "maximum intensity" to be able to adjust. There are no other settings. On the ones that have no issues there is an entire page of settings and you have to scroll down to see them all.. such as shoulder width, body size, massage program, massage technique, speed, etc. 
2. Under the "quick start buttons" tab- we have 4 massage programs set up, but there is no "quick start" option at the bottom to turn on or off.. this is ON on the Wellsystem's that we don't have issues with but we do not even have this option on this one. 
3. Under the "permissions during use" tab- we do not have a few of the options such as light program, or aroma, to be able to adjust. 

So here is the issue.. 

-All of the Wellsystems we have are set up with Tmax timers. We switch the "Device access" to coin-device active so they are controlled by the timers. We have had no issues doing this with any of them, besides this one. When we switch this one from "Unit Freely Accessible" to "Coin-device active" it starts and stops from the timer as normal but it NEVER runs for the time we send to it. We process 20 minute sessions and each time it cuts off around 8 minutes.. there is still 12 minutes left on the timer but the Wellsystem just ends the session. When we turn it back to Unit Freely Accessible, it has no issues running for 20 minutes. The timer, timer chip, and all other parts related to the tmax are all new and set up correctly so I am not sure what the issue is. 

I'm not sure if this has anything to do with it, but on the "unit information" tab of the settings under the "software information list" there are a few things that did not match the "version" displayed in the other Wellsystems we have.
-Main Control (8) the version displayed is 1.12 (It is 1.14 on the others)
-Control Center (94) the version displayed is 5.1 (It is 5.3 on the others)

Lastly, there was one active error under the "error history" tab- E531 which reads System announcement: Frequency converter pump communication with sequence control disturbed. I²C-bus from the FU to the motor control system (Wellsystem) or control board (Wellsystem plus) is faulty. 

I have gathered all of this information in hopes of someone knowing what the issue is so I can get this Wellsystem running with the timer like the other ones. Attached you will find the SN as well. Please let me know if any additional information is needed and I appreciate any/all assistance. Thanks!

Subject: 10868 - How to recover SunLync data
Description:
Good afternoon.  Thank you for contacting SunLync Support.  As mentioned on our call, here is how to get a copy of your SunLync data files from the server:

 

First, make sure the MySQL service is not running.  You can type services.msc in the Run box to get to the list of services.  Then locate the service.  It should be named “MySQL57” , “MySQL55”, or “MySQL” depending on the version installed:

If the status is “Running”, then stop the service.

 

Next, locate the SunLync data folder.  Depending on your MySQL version, it is most likely in one of the following two locations:

C:\ProgramData\MySQL\MySQL Server 5.7\Data\

C:\ProgramData\MySQL\MySQL Server 5.5\Data\

You should see a folder called “sunlync”.  Copy that to a USB drive.  Please also take note of the version in the path as we will need to restore to the same version.  If it is not present in the above two locations you may have a custom data location set up.

 

Please let us know if you have any questions or concerns.

Subject: 11205 - T-Max / TServer troubleshooting recommendations
Description:
Good afternoon.  Thank you for contacting SunLync Support.  As requested, here are some recommendations for troubleshooting the T-Max / TServer issues.

 

Have a bed technician check the hardware to ensure there are no issues there.

 

Make sure the USB to serial is plugged directly into the computer and not a USB hub.  A USB hub is like a splitter that plugs into one USB port, and provides multiple USB ports.

 

Try a new USB to serial adapter.  We recommend this one:

https://www.amazon.com/Adapter-FT232RL-Chipset-Supports-Windows/dp/B08T92M9KP?th=1

I recommend calling us before attempting to switch it out, as there may be some configuration changes needed to make it work.

 

When the issue does happen and the timer in the room is displaying 0, I recommend checking the T-Max Manager and taking note of what it shows and whether it agrees with the timer in the room or with what SunLync and TServer are reporting.

 

Your case number is #11205.  Please let us know if you have any questions or concerns.

Description:
Hello Sunlync, 

It has been over two weeks now since we asked for support as our entire chain was down again, and Management Reports have been turned off. We would appreciate a response so we can get back to normal and make any changes for best practices to limit our chain from going down again. 

Thank you,  

On Sun, Mar 16, 2025 at 12:08 PM Stephan Wurzburg <stephan@tanrepublic.com> wrote:

Support,

At 11:58pm Management reports attempted to update its temp tables when triggered by the event scheduler or some other Sunlync setting. 

However, it would not complete and kept getting stuck in a recursive loop trying to update the table and pull the data, thus locking Transactions, Payments, Equipment, and several other tables due to MyISAM full table lock. 

Server CPU never exceeded 30% and RAM was consistent as well, so not a hardware issue with the server or enough resources for it to process. 

I'll be diving in later to the replication logs to see the full query but here is an example pulled quickly- 
SELECT SUM(p.Amount)    FROM Payments p, PaymentTypes pt   WHERE p.StoreCode in (select Distinct x.Storecode                            from XTEMPDAILYSTATS x)     AND p.Voided         = 0     AND p.Date > "2025-01-01"     AND p.Date < "2025-03-17"     AND p.ReceiptNo in (select t.ReceiptNo                           from Transactions t                          where t.TranType in ("G", "R")                            and t.Voided = 0)     AND pt.PaymentNumber = p.PaymentNumber     AND pt.Class         = "G" /* statement may be truncated *



Was able to resolve the issue by turning off Management reports from the GUI. 

1 - No Windows configurations were changed or Windows updates processed during that time
2 - No DB changes or updates during the time frame as well

Subject: 1050 E40 Tips
Description:
Hey Collin!

Thanks for talking with me today. Here is the steps for the E40 below, please reach back out if this does not resolve it.

Possible error sources are:

1. the air flow switch is defective.

- Use your finger to move switch rapidly for 30 to 60 seconds, to clean contacts.
**2.** cable connection to the air flow switch is defective.
**3.** Main fan or main fan’s capacitor is defective.

- does fan run when you start the unit?
**4.** defect of PCB fan board speed control.
**5.** air not able to move through the exhaust duct system. Remove duct to test.
**6.** main fan’s rotation speed set too slow. (only for Electronic II)

Description:
Hey Brittany,

Here are the steps we discussed today. Try this and call us back if this doesnt work.

**Possible Causes**

1. If you are using a firewall or any kind of web blocker, the connection to Cayan's Site may be compromised.
2. After a Windows update runs and installs updates on the workstation, some Internet Options may need to be adjusted.
3. Cayan's site is down.

**Possible Resolutions**

- Add** **https://ps1.merchantware.net to the **Trusted Sites** on your PC.

1. Click on your start button
2. In the search bar, type "Internet Options"
3. Click on internet options
4. Navigate to the security tab
5. Select **Trusted Sites **icon (Normally represented by a Green checkmark)
6. Click the sites button
7. Type** **https://ps1.merchantware.net in the Add this website to the zone text box then click Add
8.

Click Close when finished



**Lower** Security level for this zone.

-

Set the setting to **Low** by **dragging** the level bar down to the **lowest** setting.



**Adjusting** Advanced Internet options: **Advanced Tab**

- **Look** for and uncheck (if checked) **Check for publisher's certificate revocation.**
- **Look **for and uncheck (if checked) **Check for server certificate revocation.**
- **Look** for and uncheck (if checked) **Check for the signatures on downloaded programs.**
- **Enable Integrated Windows Authentication**.
- **Enable native XMLHTTP support.**
-

Enable TLS 1.2

Subject: Re: 14770 - Issue with partial approval
Description:
No, nothing was set up different on this. The problem is that with SunLync, when a card comes back approved for a partial amount it only allows you to pick from CASH payment types for the remaining balance. And because payment types can't be salon specific it shows them to everyone. There are a couple like this. So when this happens the employee has no choice but to pick one to finalize the transaction. If they hit cancel, the transaction cancels, but the customer card is still charged - it doesn't void.

Ms. Colleen is having issues with her AMB250-15m with the facial lamps not working. She did just relamp her bed, and facial lamps we’re working before the relamp.  Colleen wasn’t comfortable with trying these things on her own and would like one of our tech in Colorado to come to the location to fix the bed, but she was trying to diagnose the problem and order parts to only have one trip from the technician.

Subject: Resolving the HELP message
Description:
Hey Brandon,

Below are the 3 different version to reset the HELP message:

Verison 1

- Cycle power to unit and unplug network cable (may need to remove plate)
- Press START, Time UP, RESET at the same time and release (00:00)
- Press Time UP and Time DOWN together and release to make colon disappear (0000)
- Press RESET once (flashing 0000)
- Press Time UP to “0102” (flashing)
- Press RESET once (solid 0002)
- Press START once (Parameter Mode)
- Press Time UP to P06 (write down value)
- Press RESET once (value flashing)
- Press Time UP and Time DOWN together (resets to 0000)
- Press RESET once (value saves)
- Press START once (exits Parameter Mode, display reboots back to HELP 1)
- Press START, Time UP, RESET at the same time and release (00:00)
- Press Time UP and Time DOWN together and release to make colon disappear (0000)
- Press RESET once (flashing 0000)
- Press Time UP to “0148”
- Press RESET once (solid 0004)
- Press START once (Parameter Mode)
- ***[Ask about exposure time]***
- ***Press Time UP to P20 (Value needs to match exposure time)
- [If not, press RESET once, Time UP or DOWN to change, RESET again]
- ***Press Time UP to P55 (Value needs to match exposure time)
- [If not, press RESET once, Time UP or DOWN to change, RESET again]
- Press START once (exits Parameter Mode, display reboots to 00:00)
- Run a 2 min. test, cycle power to reconnect network cable, rescan up front

Version 2

- Cycle power and unplug network cable (may need to remove plate)
- Press START, Time UP, RESET until “HELP” clears and “0000” is displayed
- [If “00:00” is shown, press Time UP and Time DOWN to clear colon]
- Press RESET once (flashing)
- Press Time UP to “0010” (flashing)
- Press RESET once (solid 0001)
- Press START once (Parameter Mode)
- Press Time UP to P06
- Press RESET once (value will flash, write down)
- *Add 100 to value* and press Time UP to reach new value
- Press RESET once (new value saves)
- Press START once (exits Parameter Mode, display reboots to 00:00)
- Test unit by running a 2 minute test

Version 3

- Unplug network cable and cycle power to unit.
- Press START, TIME UP, and RESET at the same time and release.
(Display should read 0000) *If there is a colon, press TIME UP and TIME DOWN at the same time and release*

- Press RESET once (flashing 0000)
- Press TIME UP to “0102” (flashing 0102)
- Press RESET once (solid 0002)
- Press START once (Parameter Mode) *P02 will show on the display and alternate with its value of 0001*
- Press TIME UP to P06 (write down the value) *If customer keeps up with the lamp hours using this parameter, you will need the value in a future step*
- Press RESET once (value flashing) then press and hold TIME UP with one thumb followed by TIME DOWN with other thumb and release. (This ensures both buttons will register together) *Display should now read 0000* Press RESET to exit parameter.
- Press START once to exit Parameter Mode *Display will now reboot showing L20 or similar software version followed by 0000*
- Press RESET once (flashing 0000)
- Press TIME UP to “0148” (flashing 0148)
- Press RESET once (solid 0004)
- Press START once (Parameter Mode) *P02 will show on the display and alternate with its value of 0001*
- ***If the customer uses P06 to check lamp hours, the value wrote down from earlier will have to be re-entered. If the customer does NOT, skip to P18 step***
- ***Press TIME UP to P06; Press RESET once (flashing 0000); Press TIME UP to lamp hour value from earlier; Press RESET once to save (solid value)*** Continue to P18 step…
- Press TIME UP to P18 (write down the value)
- Press RESET once (value flashing) then press and hold TIME UP with one thumb followed by TIME DOWN with other thumb and release. (This ensures both buttons will register together) *Display should now read 0000* Press RESET to exit parameter.
- Press TIME UP to P19 (write down the value)
- Press RESET once (value flashing) then press and hold TIME UP with one thumb followed by TIME DOWN with other thumb and release. (This ensures both buttons will register together) *Display should now read 0000* Press RESET to exit parameter.
- Press TIME UP to P20 *Ask and note if unit is a 10 min or 20 min*
- Press TIME UP to P48. Now press RESET once to flash current value then using the [yellow facial buttons], press and hold FACIAL UP and FACIAL DOWN then release to change the value to 9998 or 9999. *May need to press and hold one then the other to ensure both buttons register together* Press RESET to exit parameter.
- [If facial buttons do not work or are missing, use TIME UP.]

Subject: E170 Steps
Description:
Hey Josh,

Here are the steps for the E170:

E 170 System message: Power supply of the fan control input is
missing *If present with E128 on 480/RVT-30, - Check incoming
voltage between each phase. If voltage is ~235~VAC Replace
Mainboard!
• This system message is displayed when the power supply
of the fan control inputs at the main board is missing.
• Possible error sources are:

1. the fuse of the fan control has blown
2.safety switch turned off relay K2
2. Plug x4 of the main board is not connected


1. Turn off and on the breaker in the
unit. Does the E170 show?
2. If yes, are any of the relays on top chattering? If No, Go to #
13.
3. If yes, Turn breaker in the unit off.
4. Check the grey wires in plugs ST/BU 61, ST/BU 62, ST/BU 63.
Leave plug connected and push the grey wires on both sides
together in the plug.
5. Turn breaker in the unit on to see if error 170 clears.
6. If Yes, Test the unit.
7. If No, turn breaker in the unit off, Turn exterior breaker off.
8. Swap the K2 and K9 relays on top of the unit.
9. Turn exterior breaker on, turn breaker in unit on, did error
170 clear.
10. If Yes, Test the unit.
11. If unit runs, the K9 relay needs to be replaced.
12. If no, a voltmeter is needed to check voltage in the
unit. Call 800-445-0624 for additional support.
13. The Temperature Fuses in the unit need to be reset.
14. There are two Temperature Fuses in in each wall
segment and there are three wall segments.
15. From the outside of the unit, remove the center metal
on the door. It has two screws at the top and two screws at
the bottom. The screws just need to be loose not removed.
16. Lift the center panel off the door segment.
17. On the outside of the door you will see an opening at
the top. In this opening near the lamp holder will be the red
reset button. Push both buttons.
18. Press the Power (Start/Stop) button on controls to see
if error clears.
19. If yes, Test unit. If no repeat #15 – 18 on the next
segment.
20. When testing the unit, check the main fans. When they
start, they should run 100% of the time. If they start/stop
the main board has a problem and need to be replaced.
If problem is not resolved, call 800-445-0624 for future assistance

Subject: Re: Continued Sunrise Issue
Description:
Hi Quinn,

The sensors you were pressing are temperature sensors.  They would shut the unit down and give a right door temp error of E088 if they were having a problem.  They wouldn't affect just those lamps.

Next spot.  Bottom of door power plug.  Need to remove lower coverplate on bottom of door with right angle screwdriver.  Inspect the plug in there, and at the bottom of the cavity in the door where you found the sensors.  Maybe a pushed out wire or damaged below.  If damaged you would need to clean up wires and splice in a new section of wire.  

If that doesn't do it, double check all your harness plugs.  Sometimes you can plug one in sideways and not realize and the door won't work properly.

After that, we will need to get with JK support copied here, if you continue to have issues with Hybrid 7200 Serial # 1540816 right door lights.

We have had a situation come up more than a few times where an employee voided a tan (that had a fee associated with it) from the floor plan view rather than from the "Misc" menu on the Customer View. Are there other ways to deal with this that might help?

We have tried training the staff, but when it's busy or if an employee is newer, it's easy to forget or overlook. Subject: BA 7200 #400 Error Fix
Description:
Hey Chris,

Here are the steps to resolve the #400 error.


1. The error is telling us the control software has a problem.
2. Max tanning time needs to be adjusted using Professional
Manager Setup.
3. Press and hold the minus button until Master-Code 0000 is
showing. Change this to 0001 using the right arrow and + button.
4. You will then see Professional Setup Manger. Press the right
arrow until you see Operation. Press the OK button.
5. You will see a new screen open saying ACTIVATED. Now press
the right arrow once and you will see the Maximum Tanning
Time. Use the + or – buttons to adjust the time to match what is
on the exposure label.
6. Allow the display to return to standby mode.
7. Using the supplied Ergoline tool, gently tighten the door screw
until you can open the rear service door.
8. Turn the internal breaker off for 60 seconds and turn it back
on.
9. Close the rear service door and back the door screw out so it is
secure.
10. Run a full test session to make sure this issue is resolved

Subject: Membership Freeze Status Changing to “Active” Too Early
Description:
Hi Jeremy,

We’ve noticed a recurring issue with how Sunlync handles membership freezes, and I’d like to request a fix for this as soon as possible.

When a member reaches the final month of their freeze period, the system is automatically updating their membership status from Frozen to Active on the first day of that month — even though they have only been charged the $5 freeze dues. This premature status change is creating several problems at the point of sale.

Here’s a specific example for reference:

*

Client: Deborah Sylvester (ID 17328)

*

Freeze Period: August, September, and October

*

Observed Behavior: On 10/1, the client was charged the $5 freeze dues. On 10/2, she came in to cancel her plan, and once that cancellation processed, her membership status changed to Cancelled but still allowed her to tan for the remainder of the month.

I’ve attached a screenshot showing this behavior.

Additionally, when the membership status shows Active (even though it’s still within the freeze period), the system allows unintended actions at the POS:

*

It allows upgrades or downgrades while the membership is frozen, applying a prorated credit as if the member had paid full monthly dues, even though they’ve only paid $5.

*

Once the upgrade or downgrade is completed, the member then regains full access to the new plan for that month.

In short, the membership status should remain “Frozen” through the end of the freeze month and only switch to Active after the final day of that month (e.g., on 10/31 or when the next full dues draw processes).

This fix is important not only to prevent early access but also to maintain accurate reporting. We rely on the membership status to calculate active member counts and average monthly dues, and having frozen memberships display as active throws off our data.

Please let me know if you need any additional details, access to our server, or more examples to review.

Best,
Paige Kaplan

Subject: Malfunction w/ Aff 800
Description:
Cx told me after sessions they can't press start/stop, so it stays dirty until they flip the breaker. I was advised that the issue is likely to be the display PCB board. I want him to look at the part number from the back of the current pcb to cross check them. 

Instructions to find the board:

To find the display pcb part number:
Open the base of the bed and turn off the internal breaker.
Close the base.
Lower the canopy acrylic. (4mm allen or Ergoline tool)
Remove the plug from the back of the display. (It just pulls straight out of the back of the display)
Remove a few small screws from the back of the display and catch the display as it falls away from the inside of the acrylic (kinda tricky)
There will be etching in the pcb with the part number. (usually 5 digits followed by the words Layout 3 or some number)
That is the part number.


------------------------------------

Issue could also be:

The membrane sticker for the start button may be torn and pushed through preventing the button from functioning

Support,

Attached is a copy of the database, along with a database general log to show what the tool was processing against the database during the import.

Please reference the following tables during your review:

SLIMCD Tables

* SlimcdRequestHeader
* SlimcdResponseHeader
* SlimcdRequestDetails
* SlimcdResponseDetails
* XtempSlimcdUpdater

Token / Audit Tables

* AccountTokens
* AccountTokensHistory
* AuditLog

-------------------------------

Summary of Issues Observed

We encountered two separate scenarios involving token expiration date values being imported incorrectly (blank / null / “00” / “0200”).

-------------------------------

Scenario 1 — 12/06/2025 (Response File Download)

On 12/06/2025, we downloaded the SLIMCD response file and found 144 tokens showing an expiration date value of “00”.

In addition, the AuditLog records reflect that the new expiration date value was written as “0200”.

-------------------------------

Scenario 2 — 01/02/2026 (Request File Upload + Missing Notifications)

On 01/02/2026, we uploaded a SLIMCD request file, unaware of the token expiration date inconsistencies introduced by the 12/06/2025 response file import.

We also noticed that we did not receive any email notifications indicating SLIMCD received the file or that a response file was ready.

Since we had not heard anything, I contacted Mike at SLIMCD and asked him to review the 01/02 request file. He confirmed that the file contained some blank expiration date values.

At that point, we corrected all token expiration issues we found across the following tables:

* Clients
* AccountTokens
* EftTranDetails

-------------------------------

Follow-Up Upload (Corrected File) — 01/11/2026

After corrections were made, we uploaded a new request file to SLIMCD on 01/11/2026. Mike reviewed the file before it was sent to the processor and confirmed there were no blank expiration dates.

We received the response file on 01/19/2026, and I had Mike back up the response file before we tested. Unfortunately, he only backed up the 01/19 response file associated with the 01/11 request.

-------------------------------

Download Results — 01/19/2026

On 01/19/2026, we ran the Download in the SLIMCD utility, and it downloaded response files for both the 01/02 and 01/11 requests.

The issue we observed on 12/06/2025 was consistent with what occurred during the 01/02/2026 response import:

* The response file for 01/02/2026 corrupted 112 tokens during import.
* The response file for 01/11/2026 imported successfully and did not corrupt any additional tokens.

Afterward, Mike restored the only backup he had available (the 01/11 response file). When I uploaded that file by itself, it processed correctly.

-------------------------------

Additional Key Observation

Mike verified the following token on SLIMCD’s side:

* This token has a new GatewayID written to the database on 01/19, with an expiration date value of “00” in our database.
* Mike confirmed the expiration dates were not “00” on SLIMCD’s side.

-------------------------------

Request / Recommendation

We are requesting that a safeguard be added to the SLIMCD utility to validate response file contents before importing into the database. Specifically, the tool should scan and prevent invalid expiration date values such as:

* blank
* null
* “00”
* “0200”

Regardless of whether the issue is caused by a bad request file or a bad response file from the processor, we would like to understand how these values are being accepted and written to the database through this utility, to prevent it moving forward.

Dillion called in reporting Error E142 on his stand-up Beauty Angel 7200 unit. He attempted to clear the error by flipping the internal breaker, but the error would not clear. We opened the service door and inspected the relays; none were found to be stuck. After clearing the error and attempting to start a session, the unit would not run and the error immediately returned.

Dillion advised that he replaced the display last week due to a faulty emergency stop button. He was instructed to review the emergency stop button wiring, as the DC positive and DC negative wires may have been installed backwards. Upon inspection, this was confirmed to be the issue. The wiring was corrected, and the error was successfully cleared. The unit is now back up and running normally.

A red light ring remains illuminated around the emergency stop button; however, the unit is functioning properly at this time. If Error E142 returns, a watchdog board may be required. Unit is currently operational.

Good morning.  As requested, here are instructions for getting a list of the next dues for customers with EFT memberships:

 

First, in Back Office, go to the Reports tab and click the Data Retrieval button:

 

First, make sure Memberships is selected in the dropdown under Additional Fields

Under the Customer Fields section, double click the First Name, Last Name, and Client Number fields to add them.

Then under the Additional Fields, add Mem. Description, Mem Status, EFT Membership, 1st Draw Date, and NextDuesAmount.

Double click EFT Membership in Fields Included to add a filter.  Comparison Type should be Equal To and Value should be True.  Then click Accept Filter.

Double click Mem Status in Fields Included to add a filter.  Comparison Type should be Equal To and Value should be Active.  Then click Accept Filter.

Start out with a record limit of 50 or 100.


Then click Retrieve Data.  If it completes in a reasonable amount of time but the number of results matches the record limit, you can incrementally multiply the record limit by 10 until it either returns all the results or takes more than a minute or so.  If it takes too long, you might want to run it after hours so it doesn’t impact performance at the stores.

Once you have all the results, you can click Export as Text on the bottom right:

 

When saving the file, make sure to include “.csv” on the end of the filename.  This will allow you to open it in Excel by default:

Subject: EVO 600 & Exc 800 start/stop issues & main fan stuck
Description:
Hello and good morning,


We currently have at least five beds that, since before my time, have sporadically experienced an intermittent but recurring issue related to session processing through SunLync. Unresolved issue #2 is the main fan becoming stuck indefinitely until power is shut off to the tanning bed on across almost every Ergoline electronics 2 unit we have. When the main fans stick on all the lamps shut off, and the bed display will be frozen at however many seconds into the session the bed glitched.


When the issue occurs, the affected bed will begin operating on its own immediately after staff process a session at the POS, then stop, and repeatedly start again until the session is reversed, the time is reset, or the bed is powered down either at the breaker or through SunLync. In some cases, the beds may go six months or longer without exhibiting this behavior, while at other times it may occur as frequently as once every month or two.


In an effort to troubleshoot and resolve this both per prior recommendations and through independent testing across multiple units and over several years I have:


  *   Replaced timer control modules on select units
  *   Replaced T-Max timer control cables
  *   Verified T-Max Manager and TCM programming, including delay times (currently set to 5 minutes on both the Manager and TCMs)
  *
Temporarily swapped matching display circuit boards between identical models to see if the issue followed the board (it did not)
  *
Eprom chip/software updates
  *
 Slotboard resets via Service PC
  *
Checked Service PC bed parameter settings
  *
Replaced fan control computer circuit boards
  *
 Replaced main computer circuit boards


There may be additional troubleshooting steps that have been attempted over the years that I am inadvertently missing, but at this point I wanted to reach out for your guidance. This issue has been a point of frustration for both staff and clients, and we’d like to resolve it as reliably as possible.


At this stage, I’m unsure whether the root cause is related to existing T-Max timer wiring or something in between, the equipment itself, or the software/communication side between the computer and timers. Any insight or recommended next steps would be greatly appreciated. I've spoken with multiple technicians and companies including JK, Applied Digital and STC over the years regarding these issues but it seems to be happening more regularly lately


Thank you for your time and assistance.

Subject: Open Sun 550
Description:
I have a customer with an Open Sun 550 s#980635 that will not work.  They bought it used and it was delivered without the timer. As it is on their home, they were interested in me bypassing the coin box option so they could start the bed without the timer.

On the X3 terminal, I tired jumping both 18-19, 10-16, 10-16+17, etc. When I press the start button on the display, I can hear the relay click on the coin box board, and have verified continuity in all the related wiring from X3 through all connections to the coinbox board in slot 4. 

I don't want to recommend they buy a timer if the bed isn't going to work with one installed. 

Lamps and fans work fine when relays are manually engaged, but not once has the main PCB engaged it's relays to activate the "K" relays. There are no error codes displayed and the safety system seems to be working properly.

If you can give some insight, or at least let me know how I can be sure that if they bought a timer, the bed would work when it is installed. 

If it is a board issue, can you let me know how to identify which one? I am assuming it must be coinbox, main, or slot PCB. I don't see any alarm LEDs on any boards, and all fuses are good.

Thanks,

Johnny

Mary called in regarding her Inspiration 450 unit. She stated that the unit has had intermittent issues for some time but had recently been running normally until the problem returned.

The unit was shutting off approximately three to five minutes early and displaying error code E025. The error could not be cleared unless the main breaker was flipped.

Mary initially attempted basic troubleshooting by removing the filter glass area to try and reactivate the safety switch in case it was not engaging properly.

After gathering additional information regarding the E025 error, it was determined that there is a buildup of dust near the facial glass area, restricting proper airflow. This airflow restriction is likely causing the unit to overheat and shut down early.

Photos highlighting the affected area were sent to Mary along with her case number for reference.

Subject: Spirit  error codes
Description:
Ray called in regarding his Spirit 42/3 unit not starting properly. He initially reported that the unit was not communicating with the T-Max system to initiate a session. A timer reset was performed, and the timer synchronized correctly with the T-Max Manager. When a session was started, the timer counted down properly; however, the unit itself did not power on. There were no visible error messages at first, and the canopy décor lights were also not functioning, leading Ray to believe it may be a power-related issue.

After accessing the preset settings to check stored error codes, we found error codes #0122 and #0126. During troubleshooting, it was discovered that the canopy safety switch was not being activated. Once the switch was properly engaged, the unit powered on and began operating normally. The unit is now back up and running.

Hi Mike! I have attached the instructions to get into parameters on the Intellitan:
 
Hold/hit up and down at the same time the : between 00:00 will disappear.
 
Should have 0000
 
hit reset
 
0000 will be flashing
 
 
hit up until 0102
 
hit reset
 
then hit start stop
 
depending on the version of the timer either up(try this first) or start stop will cycle through the parameters.
 
If it is start/stop, go slow, if you go past the parameter we need, you have to start over. 
 
once at the parameter you are needing to change, hit reset and hit up until you get to the value. Once at the correct value, hit reset.
 
Parameter 5 is Room number (Room number of location, 7 in this example, if this does not work you can try a value of 1)

Skin Type assessment must have a numerical value assigned.

Each tanning facility must determine every client’s skin type in order to establish an appropriate tanning exposure schedule.

If the assessment is not performed using an approved skin‑typing device, the questionnaire used must include questions about:

* Sun sensitivity

* Relevant medical history

Subject: SR 7200 - #0103
Description:
0103 error code on SR 7200. Reset the temperature fuses and error cleared.

Steps on clearing error:

Step out of the unit
Close the two doors
Take a half step to the right
You will see 5 screws on the right hand side panel facing you
You take the screws out and the panel opens like a door
Top right corner - two temperature fuses
Press those (two little black round pieces with spade connectors going into both sides and it'll have a black or red button). Just touch them, you should hear a click if the power is on, if he hears that, it's fixed

Heard click, pressed start stop on display and error cleared.

1. We’ve received a few reports from salons stating that the “Customer may not tan until [time] on [day], [date , year]” in the POS Messages is missing in the v10.0.0.7 of SunLync.

We understand that this was likely a purposeful change in v10.0.0.7 - but wanted to inquire if there is a way to get this feature added back into SunLync in a future version.

The customer tan time in POS Messages allows the employees to locate the customer’s next tan time more quickly than having to go to session history.

Version 9.1.8.8 of SunLync - next customer tan time populates at the top of POS Messages.

  Version 10.0.0.7 of SunLync - customer tan time is only available in “Tanning History” or within F5 Process Service > Session History

The employees are having to rely on the equipment being crossed out within SunLync, leading to delays when informing the customer that they are unable to tan using UV Equipment.

We also understand that this was likely a purposeful change in v10.0.0.7, with the F5 Tan and Other Service being combined into F5 Process Service. We wanted to inquire on whether there was a way to get this feature added back into SunLync in a future version.  If this feature is combined with the above enhancement request and is listed under POS Messages rather than being a popup window within SunLync - that would work as well.

 

Please let us know if we can provide further details.

Good afternoon,

We are continuing to experience the same issue with our Hybrid tanning unit Serial #: 1631126. This problem began on March 6, when we submitted our first ticket with our maintenance team.
Initially, we believed the error code indicated that the tanning bulbs needed to be replaced. We changed the bulbs on March 14; however, at that point the U card would not read. We had to wait until Monday, March 16 to contact tech support. JK support assisted us by sending a new U card, which arrived the next business day on March 17 (JK ticket #30070 for reference).
On March 17, I attempted to use the new U card to update the unit, but it still did not work. I contacted JK support again and provided the error code (#0104). At that time, we were informed that the issue was due to overheating. I was walked through removing the front panel and resetting the internal breaker, which resolved the issue temporarily.
The unit functioned properly until April 2, when it displayed a new error code (#0400). We were able to clear this error by flipping the breaker inside the door, turning the bed off, and then back on.
On April 7, the same unit began displaying error code #0104 (overheating) again. I removed the panel and reset the internal breaker on April 8 when I returned to work. However, by April 10, the error had returned. I reset it again the morning of the 10th, but by Saturday the unit was back in error. We left it out of order all weekend.
I reset the unit again this morning, and it is already overheating once more.

Bryan called in reporting an E057 error on his Laydown 42/4 unit. He stated that no recent work had been done on the facial lamps. After resetting the error and power cycling the unit, the error message cleared and the unit returned to normal operation.

Bryan also mentioned ongoing overheating issues affecting multiple units at the facility, likely due to smaller room sizes and limited airflow. I advised that if the E057 error returns during or after a session, it is most likely related to overheating. As long as the main fan is functioning properly and the bellows are correctly installed, additional room cooling or improved ventilation may be necessary to prevent the issue from recurring.

On the very end of the bed, he will see a black circular piece that goes on the end of the acrylic, kind of where the bottom acrylic and side section meet. 1 screw holds it on; there is one on the left and right of the bed. Remove the screw and pull off.

 

Drop the side section with the acrylic tool. He should see a corner turn lock on the left and right of the metal above side section acrylic.

 

get a second person and lift up and out to remove the acrylic

 

Will see some rivets on the backside of the bottom acrylic frame...Remove the rivets....I usually press into them with my drill until it eats through them. Spray some bed cleaner down the back of the frame and it will help you pull the acrylic and seal from the frame. Start pulling the acrylic on one end to start removing it. May have to pull on side section too. Bottom acrylic should then be removed.

 

Then borrow the seal from the old acrylic, or if you have a new one place it onto the new acrylic. Spray it down with soapy water or bed cleaner

 

Then push the side section and bottom acrylic frame onto the new acrylic. Once you have it mounted install new push rivets where we took out the old ones on the underside of the metal frame of the bottom acrylic

 

Then we can put the acrylic back in the bed

 

Then remove the black plastic pieces that the screw went through from the old acrylic and mount on to the new acrylic.

 

Screw acrylic down 

 

turn on power

 

Should be good…

 

Let me know if you have any questions, I will be happy to help however I can.

Subject: Give Packages - SunLync Version 10
Description:
I am wondering if the newer builds of Version 10 have a change for a situation we're running into with Give Packages.

Details:
We have a membership called Glo One - it is sold at most of our locations. One of the locations would like to include a body contouring session with their monthly dues. The intent was for them to be able to include this while not including it at all locations, and also not having to create a whole separate membership for one location.

Setup:
EFT Membership - Glo One Signature EFT, associated with all locations.
Package - Body Contouring - EFT Session (VIC), associated only with the one location, the equipment is a piece of equipment associated only with that location.
Give Package - Set to give the above package to those with the above membership.

When applying the give package it applies to anyone with the membership regardless of their location affiliation.
I tried checking the box that says it can only be used at the location it was purchased, but the give package process associates the package with the location that the membership belongs to - this is actually ideal, I'm not suggesting a change to that at all, nor would I expect something like that to be approved, I'm just trying to give as much info and detail as possible.

I am hoping to see if there is a change or a possible change that will only apply it to locations where the package is associated. How do I open and close a cash drawer?



SunLync has a built-in feature to help you count, close, and track cash drawer figures. You may already be familiar with the End of Shift Drawer Count pop-up when closing POS. This is SunLync checking to see if you want to close out and count the cash drawer.



  *   Count: Use this if you want to count the cash drawer now, at the computer right now.

  *   Drop: Drop off the drawer in a safe place like a locked safe to be counted later or take to another computer to count there.

  *   Ignore: Keep the drawer open, will close out later.



[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]



Stepping back to the beginning, we must open the drawer. SunLync opens a drawer when completing the first transaction on a new drawer. Based on your SunLync settings, this may happen in the background automatically. To bring this to the front end, log into the Back Office and go to Store Parameters. The Peripherals Settings include controlling how the cash drawer works. Set the default starting cash and checkmark “Prompt for starting cash amount when a drawer is opened”.





[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]









[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]





SunLync will only show the Starting Cash Drawer Amount pop-up after completing the first sale. Since sometimes there is a gap between putting the cash drawer in and completing the first sale. Processing a $0 transaction, like a tan on an employee’s membership, will ensure the drawer is ready right away.



Along with closing SunLync POS to count or drop a drawer. You can click on Count/Drop at POS to pull up the End of Shift Drawer Count pop-up window.



[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]





After selecting Count and the employee doing the count. Enter in the amounts for the payment types completed in the drawer. The numbers will default to $0.



For card and check payment. You may have to run a report in SunLync, your payment provider portal, or print store copies of receipts to put into the cash drawer to get those counts.



When counting the cash, you can use the built in calculator. To count by denominations instead of dollar amounts.





[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]

Next, confirm how much if any cash will be left in the drawer.



[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]



The drawer is now counted and closed. If you use the “Use recommended distribution” setting in Store Parameters, you will see a screen like below instead. Which includes recommendations on what denominations you should leave in the drawer for the next cashier.



[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]



After counting a drawer, you can Edit Amounts if needed. SunLync will track adjustments and flag the drawer as being adjusted and reports.



[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]







[A screenshot of a computer    Description automatically generated]



Included with SunLync are the Drawer Figures and Drawer Figures Summary reports. That allows you to easily see the counts and any variances between them.

  - Change default-storage-engine=INNODB to default-storage-engine=MyISAM
  - Change sql-mode="Strict_Trans_Tables,No_Auto_Create_user,No_Engine_Substitition" to sql-mode=""
  - When saving, make sure it is using the ANSI encoding
  - After updating the file, apply the changes by restarting the MySQL service
  - Make sure you have these done before importing the data

- Create a MySQL user named sunlync and write down the password
  - This user should have privileges for alter, create, delete, drop, index, insert, select, and update

- You will need to configure the following settings (which can be done via Workbench if you installed it)
  - key_buffer_size can be up to 25% of the system RAM, but probably doesn't need to go over 1 or 2 gigabytes
  - query_cache_type should be checked and set to 1
  - query_cache_size should be checked set to 1048576 (this is usually the default)
  - These changes can also be applied by restarting the MySQL service


You will also need the SunLync installer:
https://sunlync.sharefile.com/public/share/web-s3d6cb47bcf724627b80ca8ad8a0a993a

I advised Susie to first verify whether the bulbs themselves are bad by moving them into known working positions within the unit. If the bulbs work in another position, then the issue is likely not with the lamps themselves.

I then advised her that the next troubleshooting step would be to swap a known working ballast into one of the affected positions to determine whether the ballast is causing the issue.

I also informed Susie that because this is an older unit, we may no longer have replacement ballasts available. However, I directed her to locate the part number on the existing ballast so she can search for the replacement part through a third-party supplier if needed.

Description:
Dan/4062083942 called in regarding issues with metering and the unit not being found by the timer system. Two timer resets were attempted, but the unit still could not be located. During troubleshooting, it was observed that after powering the bed off, the antenna signal was strong enough for the unit to be found, likely due to the timer's proximity to the top of the unit.

After reviewing the logs and conducting additional research, it was determined that the issue is related to the timer configuration inside the bed. To correct the issue, the timer inside the bed will need to have the room address (Parameter .1) set to 1. Additionally, Parameter 19 (displayed as 1.9) will need to be changed to 1. These settings will allow the unit to properly communicate with and read external timers. This information was provided to Dan for further troubleshooting.

Subject: API Gift Voucher Sales Not Appearing in SunLync Sales Reporting
Description:
Hi all the Sunlync Team.

We have been testing the API with the goal of selling gift vouchers online and, overall, the API process appears to be working well.

Using the API we are successfully able to:

*

Create transactions

*

Create payments

*

Create gift vouchers

*

Create vouchers that can be found within SunLync

*

Confirm voucher balances

*

Redeem vouchers through the normal SunLync process

From a functional point of view, the vouchers appear to be created correctly and are fully usable.

However, we have noticed that sales created via the API are not being recorded in SunLync reporting in the same way as sales created through the desktop application.

For example:

*

The voucher exists and has the correct balance.

*

The transaction appears in client history.

*

The payment appears to be recorded against the client history.

*

The voucher can be located and redeemed.

However, the payment and sale do not appear to be recorded as normal salon sales within SunLync reporting. We cannot find the corresponding revenue in the standard salon, corporate, or mobile sales reports generated by SunLync.

To verify this was not specific to gift vouchers, we also tested a normal product sale through the API and observed the same behaviour. The transaction was created successfully and appeared in the client history, but was not reflected in SunLync sales reporting.

Specifically:

*

The sale does not appear in Daily Sales reports.

*

The sale does not appear in Sales Detail reports.

*

The sale does not appear in Mobile App sales totals.

*

The revenue does not appear to be included in the normal salon or corporate sales reporting generated by SunLync.

*

The transaction can be found from the client perspective, but not from the business reporting perspective.

We investigated the database and found some differences between a desktop-generated sale and an API-generated sale. One example is that desktop transactions are associated with a valid DrawerFigureID, whereas API transactions are inserted with DrawerFigureID = 9999999999.

However, we do not know whether this is the actual cause of the reporting issue or simply one of several differences between API and desktop transactions.

Our main question is:

Is there an additional API call, process, or required field that must be completed in order for an API-created transaction to be fully recognised by SunLync as a normal sale and included in all standard sales and financial reporting?

From our testing, the API is successfully creating the voucher and related records, but it appears that some final step may be missing before SunLync treats the transaction as a fully posted sale.

Separate question:

At the moment, we are manually supplying the gift voucher number when creating a voucher through the API. For a future online voucher solution, we would ideally like SunLync to generate a unique voucher number automatically, in the same way that vouchers are generated within the desktop application.

Could you please advise what the recommended API process is for generating a new unique gift voucher number?

Any guidance would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Tomasz

Subject: Display problem on 6200
Description:
Brian Seamans/
Brian called in regarding a display issue on his Sunrise 6200. He recently installed a new display and was concerned that the harness might be causing the problem. During troubleshooting, Brian confirmed that the display powers up normally and appears to be functioning correctly visually. However, when he presses certain areas of the touchscreen, the display does not respond as expected.

I asked Brian if the display had been tightened securely during installation, and he confirmed that it had. I advised him that in some cases the display board and front touchscreen can be overtightened during installation, which may cause touch functionality issues. I recommended loosening the mounting hardware by a couple of turns and testing the display again. If that does not resolve the issue, I suggested placing a very small spacer between the board and the front touchscreen to see if that restores proper operation.

I provided Brian with the case number and advised him to call back if these steps do not resolve the issue so we can continue troubleshooting.

How do I open and close a cash drawer? 

 

SunLync has a built-in feature to help you count, close, and track cash drawer figures. You may already be familiar with the End of Shift Drawer Count pop-up when closing POS. This is SunLync checking to see if you want to close out and count the cash drawer. 

 

* Count: Use this if you want to count the cash drawer now, at the computer right now. 

* Drop: Drop off the drawer in a safe place like a locked safe to be counted later or take to another computer to count there. 

* Ignore: Keep the drawer open, will close out later. 

 

 

 

Stepping back to the beginning, we must open the drawer. SunLync opens a drawer when completing the first transaction on a new drawer. Based on your SunLync settings, this may happen in the background automatically. To bring this to the front end, log into the Back Office and go to Store Parameters. The Peripherals Settings include controlling how the cash drawer works. Set the default starting cash and checkmark “Prompt for starting cash amount when a drawer is opened”.  

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

SunLync will only show the Starting Cash Drawer Amount pop-up after completing the first sale. Since sometimes there is a gap between putting the cash drawer in and completing the first sale. Processing a $0 transaction, like a tan on an employee’s membership, will ensure the drawer is ready right away. 

 

Along with closing SunLync POS to count or drop a drawer. You can click on Count/Drop at POS to pull up the End of Shift Drawer Count pop-up window. 

 

 

 

 

After selecting Count and the employee doing the count. Enter in the amounts for the payment types completed in the drawer. The numbers will default to $0. 

 

For card and check payment. You may have to run a report in SunLync, your payment provider portal, or print store copies of receipts to put into the cash drawer to get those counts.  

 

When counting the cash, you can use the built in calculator. To count by denominations instead of dollar amounts. 

 

 

 

Next, confirm how much if any cash will be left in the drawer. 

 

 

 

The drawer is now counted and closed. If you use the “Use recommended distribution” setting in Store Parameters, you will see a screen like below instead. Which includes recommendations on what denominations you should leave in the drawer for the next cashier.

Description:

Their unit is randomly shutting off and on during sessions and they are unable to finish sessions as usual. So I attempted to do a timer reset, however this is an older bed with a 4 button timer. We got as far as the following instructions:

-Turn off unit’s power, locate and disconnect tmax network cable from timer, power on
-When timer shows 00:00, press UP and DOWN together and release to get rid of the colon (00 00)
-Press and release the RESET button so 00 00 flashes
-Press and hold UP until you reach 01 02 (use DOWN if you pass it)
-Press and release the RESET button to show a solid 00 02
-Press and release the START button and you should see P02 then 0001

When he tried the last step above L037 flashed then 00:00 popped up. 

Sent him to level 2 for further assistance.

Subject: T-Max Touch setup
Description:
Good afternoon.  As discussed on our call, here are the instructions for setting up the T-Max Touch:

First, install the drivers as described in this guide:
https://tmaxtimers.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/T-Max-Manager-Touch-USB-Driver-Guide-.pdf
The download link in the guide doesn't appear to work, so here is one that does:
https://tmaxtimers.com/software/T-Max%20Manager%20Touch%20USB%20Driver.exe

Once the drivers are installed, take note of the COM Port number that shows next to the Silicon Labs device in Device Manager.
Then open SunINI on the computer the T-Max is connected to.  If you don't have a desktop shortcut, you can search the start menu:
 ![](https://jkamerica.zendesk.com/attachments/token/9Ecv4JRlvT2Fb6PoGyEKV4rZw/?name=image.png)
You can also access SunINI by clicking the small folder button on the SunLync login prompt:
 ![](https://jkamerica.zendesk.com/attachments/token/ADf5eJcSb5rSyr5PdKT491spd/?name=image.png)

In SunINI, navigate to the Timer Settings page under the Timer Server section.
Change the COM Port number to match what Device Manager shows, then click Save and Close.
 ![](https://jkamerica.zendesk.com/attachments/token/iVqDEx770ZY9IdyUUFezu8YCJ/?name=image.png)

To apply the change, close out of POS and TServer if they are open, then relaunch POS.
To close TServer, first click the small up arrow near the system clock on the right side of the taskbar.
Then right click the icon that looks like a small light blue analog clock, and choose Close.
 ![](https://jkamerica.zendesk.com/attachments/token/oI0ihfId1tYiJPO5BmmWmkYYc/?name=image.png)

Once the changes have been applied, I recommend sending a test to a bed to make sure everything works.  Please let us know if you need further assistance, or if you have any questions or concerns.

Thanks,
Jeremy

To access the interference filter:

Above the ballast trays, remove the bottom décor lamp that shines upward from the bottom of the unit.
Remove the access panel behind the décor lamp.
Behind this panel, you will find the incoming terminal block and the interference filter.

Evan will inspect this area and follow up with the results.

Subject: Sunlync Bugs
Description:
Hello,

Gary and Charles recently visited us here at Beaches Tanning and Spa and I had a list of bugs that I caught in Sunlync that Gary asked me to pass along.

Version 10 Bugs
Point of Sale:

  1.
One of the new features in version 10 was that the Memberships in the membership tab would be sorted by active membership first. However, if someone's membership is frozen or on hold, you still have to sort through old/expired memberships to find the frozen membership. Here is a screenshot example of one of our customers. Photo #1 is the example of what her account looks like when you first click on the memberships tab. Photo #2 is where I found her frozen membership. Instead of sorting by Active memberships only, can we also move frozen and on hold memberships to the top as well?

[cid:5a8cc2b7-35c8-4043-9606-dc9d94277469]

[cid:b06e4122-9877-4b3f-915f-1a55744d15a0]

I also provided Tim with this case number and advised him to follow up if the issue persists after completing the recommended cleaning.

Hey guys, Kalob Powell here with Planet Fitness. I’m reaching out today to see if either of you have any availability to come to the Grand Blanc Club and help us get this bed running again. 
Here’s the breakdown of what’s going on, 

The bed isn’t starting up, I’ve checked all wiring and breakers. The unit has power and I can confirm that time from the T-Maxx manager at the desk  is being successfully sent to the unit. The keypad is unresponsive but still makes noise when touching it upon attempt at start up. 
When time is sent from the T-Maxx Manager to the bed the keypad won’t work to start it at all. I have to start it with the actual T-Max receiver on the exterior of the bed. However, when I press start on that, the bed responds like it’s working and says “welcome, your tanning session starts now” but after that nothing happens. The bed still doesn’t light but the exterior T-Max receiver does count down the time remaining on the session. 
After the session is over, the bed says “thank you, we hope that you enjoyed your tanning session and look forward to next time”. So the bed just isn’t lighting, I don’t believe this is a T-Max issue, I believe this is a control board and/or wiring issue honestly. 

There are no error codes on this unit. 
Kalob Powell <kpowell@impact-fitness.com>

Description:
Support,

We encountered an issue during the Greenwood Village 8/1 EFT batch submission that we have not seen before.

During the submission, the batch totals went into the negatives, and the logs do not contain the complete batch results. I do not believe "Enable Logging" was enabled for the EFT batch process before the submission, so the attached logs are all that were captured after the issue occurred.

The immediate impact is that approximately 80 transactions remain in an "Open" status. Before we can post the batch, we now have to manually determine which of those transactions were actually processed successfully and update the batch records accordingly. If we do not, we risk submitting duplicate transactions and double-charging clients. The ccprocessinglog shows the few attempts that were made the "Remaining to be billed" value become negative. Those records show failed errors like "Duplicate Transaction already exists".

I'm not sure where the disconnect occurred. The workstation maintained a stable internet connection throughout the process, and I was remotely connected while monitoring the batch and capturing screenshots.

A similar issue also occurred during the Castle Rock batch submission. In that case, I noticed it almost immediately and was able to also capture a screenshot.

At this point, all other batches have been posted without issue. Greenwood Village is the only batch still pending while we wait for guidance.

Could you also advise whether there is an updated version we can install on both the server and workstations so they are running the same build? Currently, the server is running version 10.0.0.7, while the workstations are running version 10.0.0.5.

Our EFT workflow is:

* Batch is created on the server (v10.0.0.7)
* Batch is submitted from an individual store workstation (v10.0.0.5)
* Batch is then posted on the server (v10.0.0.7)

Please let us know how you would like us to proceed with the Greenwood Village batch and whether matching software versions are recommended.




Respectfully,

Subject: JK America Support - Case #00038996: Re: Service & Parts Request | Teresa Root - Ticket Number 23029
Description:
This is a follow-up to your previous request #23029 "Service & Parts Request | T..."

Intellitan 4 button timers are only slightly different. I am pasting some instructions below.

4 button timer reset:

-Turn off unit’s power, locate and disconnect tmax network cable from timer, power on

-When timer shows 00:00, press UP and DOWN together and release to get rid of the colon (00 00)

-Press and release the RESET button so 00 00 flashes

-Press and hold UP until you reach 01 02 (use DOWN if you pass it)

-Press and release the RESET button to show a solid 00 02

-Press and release the START button and you should see P02 then 0001

-Press and release the START button until you see P05 and its current value (Room address parameter)

-Press and release the RESET button so current value flashes then use UP or DOWN to change to 0255 (or 0254 if you cannot get to 0255)

-Press and release the RESET button and you should see 9999

-Power off internal breaker for 30 seconds

-Power on then timer should go to 00:00

-Press and release UP to add 1 minute (01:00) then press START button twice to run the bed


-Once that session finishes, go back into Parameters:

-When timer shows 00:00, press UP and DOWN together and release to get rid of the colon (00 00)

-Press and release the RESET button so 00 00 flashes

-Press and hold UP until you reach 01 02 (use DOWN if you pass it)

-Press and release the RESET button to show a solid 00 02

-Press and release the START button and you should see P02 then 0001

-Press and release the START button until you see P05 and its current value (Room address parameter)

-Press and release the RESET button so current value flashes then use UP to set to correct number and press and release RESET button to save

-Press and release the START button until you see P15 then its current value (0001 is ON, 0000 is OFF)

-If current value is 0001, continue pressing and releasing START button until 00:00 is shown; if not, press and release RESET button to correct then RESET button once more to save.

-Once timer is back to 00:00, reconnect tmax network cable then cycle power to front desk controller then test

We performed a timer reset to ensure the system was communicating properly. The unit was found by the timer, and when the system started the session, the lamps still did not turn on. We checked the incoming power and received the following readings: L1 to L2 was 240V, L1 to L3 was 240V, and L2 to L3 was 243V.

We attempted turning off all of the internal breakers in the unit to see if this made any difference. While I was getting Mario to check the outgoing power from the main relays, the call was disconnected.

Josh instead removed the fuses from the power block to turn the unit off. I did not instruct him to remove the fuses and only advised him to use the internal breaker to safely power down the unit.

After closing the unit and locating the timer control module, Josh unplugged the network cable and found that there was no power going to the timer control module.

Josh said this is his first time seeing this timer control module, which may explain why the unit was offline. Josh does not currently have a multimeter available to verify voltage at the timer. He will have an electrician check the power coming from the port connected to the timer to confirm it is receiving the proper voltage. If proper voltage is confirmed at the timer connection, a replacement timer may be needed. Provided Josh with the unit schematic and timer reset manual for reference.

I've found the solution for the problem of the lag of 6 minutes when running the report Product Sales.

It appeared that the rpt still contains this printer: \\PRINT\HP_LaserJet_1020<file://PRINT/HP_LaserJet_1020>. So when the Crystal Reports runtime (crpe32/craxdrt 11.5.8.826) loads the report, it opens that printer ten times (OpenPrinter followed by DeviceCapabilities each time). On a customer PC the host name "PRINT" cannot be resolved, so every call waits for the Windows name-resolution timeout.

Subject: Entire right side out/BA7200
Description:
Dave called in with an issue on his Beauty Angel 7200, where the entire right side, including the right side panel and right side door, is not lighting. We checked the internal breakers and cycled them off and back on, but this did not resolve the issue. We verified that all breakers were supplying power and that the relays were functioning properly and sending power out.

We then checked the incoming power across all three legs and confirmed 240 volts between L1 and L2, L1 and L3, and L2 and L3. Dave also verified that the ballasts in the affected panels were receiving power. We inspected the wiring running from the circuit box to each panel to ensure there were no damaged, frayed, loose, or disconnected cables. Finally, we swapped the left and right door harness connections at the bottom of the circuit box, but the issue remained on the right side.

Sending to Level 2 for further troubleshooting help.

Subject: Lamps out
Description:
Darrell/6186943272 called in reporting that not all lamps are lighting on his Inspiration 600 unit. He stated that every other lamp on the base was lighting, with the same issue occurring intermittently on the canopy. Incoming power has not been checked recently, but Darrell reported that when it was last tested about a month ago, all three legs were reading 230 volts.
I recommended verifying the incoming power and checking the breakers to ensure no cables are loose, damaged, or burnt. After reseating and turning off the middle internal breaker, Darrell was able to get the base lamps working, leaving only the canopy affected. Since everything else appeared to be in order, I recommended checking the capacitors, as a faulty or burnt capacitor may cause the internal breaker to trip.
I sent Darrell the case number, a photo of the schematic, and a reference photo showing how to access the capacitors on this unit. He will call back after checking the capacitors with his multimeter, which he currently has at another facility.
